notes.title: Steam Achievements Available!
notes.content:
We updated the game with Steam Achievements!

A total of 26 achievements are ready for you to unlock! Do you have what it takes to get them all? Let us know if they are working fine. :)

Also we fixed and updated some bugs reported inside the game, and some errors with the translation.


Enjoy them!

notes.title: Artbook and OST now available!
notes.content:
Hello! If you already bought the game you should receive a new UPDATE! 

This one includes:
[h1]Original Soundtrack and the Artbook from Samsa![/h1]
You will be able to listen the music and see the beautiful art, if you look inside the installation folder, there should be two new features:

[h1]- Samsa OST
- The Art of Samsa[/h1]

For new purchases, the Art and OST will be downloaded automatically.
Hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: Samsa and the Knights of Light now available on STEAM!
notes.content:
Samsa and the Knights of Light is Now Available on Steam and is 20% off to celebrate!

Samsa and the Knights of Light is a RPG game, with 2D retro-style. The game takes you into the story of SAMSA, a strong but lazy demon who wants to save the world, his way. While going against a society that judges him for every action, SAMSA can show that you shouldn't judge a book for it's cover.

SAMSA is the main character in the story, and his name means "Shadow", the place from where he was saved. In the game you will find DIFFERENT CHARACTERS, every one of them with their own abilities and personality. 


You will have to work, fight and grow your character's reputation. You can even go out on a date and try to get a couple.
The choice is yours, be what you wanna be, and live like you wanna be remembered.
